facts.material: Outer surface of PVC plastic sheeting; polyester textile lining; zipper closure
facts.function: Women's handbag for carrying personal effects
facts.form: Finished, complete handbag with two shoulder straps, zipper top closure and lining
facts.end_use: Everyday personal carry by women; retail about $45 (designed for prolonged use)

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 4202 names handbags of sheeting of plastics; Section VIII notes give no exclusion and chapter 42 note 2 excludes none of this good

GRI 1: chapter 42 note 3(A)(a) sends only plastic-sheeting bags with handles not designed for prolonged use to 3923; a lined, zippered, strapped $45 handbag is designed for prolonged use, so heading 3923 does not apply

GRI 6: 4202.22 handbags with outer surface of sheeting of plastics or textile materials (compared with 4202.21 leather and 4202.29 other); chapter 42 additional US note 2 treats coated fabric by exterior surface, here plastic
GRI 6: 4202.22.15.00 with outer surface of sheeting of plastics; the lining does not change the outer surface

rejected_alternatives.reason: Chapter 42 note 3(A)(a) covers only plastic bags with handles not designed for prolonged use; this lined, zippered handbag is designed for prolonged use
Outer surface is plastic sheeting, not leather or composition leather
Other handbags; this bag is specifically provided for under 4202.22 by outer surface
Travel, sports and similar bags, not handbags
Outer surface of textile materials; the outer surface is PVC sheeting, and the polyester is only the lining

missing_facts: Confirm the exterior is PVC sheeting on the majority of the visible outer surface (stated in the description)
classification.rationale: Heading 4202 covers handbags whether or not with shoulder strap, of sheeting of plastics. Chapter 42 note 3(A)(a) does not remove it to 3923 because the lined, zippered bag is designed for prolonged use. GRI 6 selects 4202.22 and the line 4202.22.15.00 (outer surface of sheeting of plastics). CROSS rulings N325256 (PVC-coated handbag, 4202.22.1500) and G83846 (PVC handbag with lining and two shoulder straps, 4202.22.1500) are in force and match the facts. validate_hts confirms the code is a current 10-digit line.
